name: Crabbox Worker Provider
description: Cloud worker provider and lease-backed sandbox backend for the Crabbox CLI.

cliCommands.name: crabbox
cliCommands.description: Inspect and recover Crabbox warm images

sandbox.description: Lease a Crabbox box for tool-call isolation with agents.defaults.sandbox.backend=crabbox. Requires a direct provider with fixed lease IDs.

provider.description: Crabbox provider for sandbox leases; defaults to the configured Crabbox selection.

class.description: Crabbox machine class for sandbox leases.

ttl.description: Maximum lease lifetime passed to crabbox warmup --ttl.

idleTimeout.description: Idle release passed to crabbox warmup --idle-timeout.

binary.description: Explicit crabbox executable; defaults to the discovered binary.

refreshAfter.description: Refresh age, at least 1h. Use 1–8 whole digits followed by m, h, or d. Pinned checkpoints are exempt. Requires Gateway restart.

retainUnused.description: Unused retention, at least 1d (24h or 1440m). Use 1–8 whole digits followed by m, h, or d. Pinned checkpoints are exempt. Requires Gateway restart.

keepPrevious.description: Retain one previous checkpoint generation for rollback. Pinned predecessors are always retained. Requires Gateway restart.
